card.title: Solution Market
card.subtitle: Browse, install and manage oj solutions
card.empty: No solutions available (market address not configured or index empty)
card.superOnly: Only superadmins can install, upgrade, roll back, enable/disable or uninstall solutions; other users may browse only.

task.trustTitle: Trust confirmation required: publisher key not in host trust store
task.trustBody: The signing key of publisher "{{keyId}}" is not trusted by this host yet (first-use TOFU).
task.trustHint: Compare this fingerprint with the one published by the vendor; confirm only if they match. Confirming retries this install automatically and reuses the staged files.
task.hintSmoke: Smoke probe failures usually mean one of two things: (1) the anonymous endpoints added by this install (auth.anonymous_paths) are pending a restart — restart the host and retry; (2) in dev the host already ships a module with the same name, so the route belongs to the source module and the probe is not hitting the freshly installed package.
task.hintCancelled: This install was cancelled: lock file, version directory and staging were restored to their pre-install state. You can retry directly.
task.hintReloading: Config hot-reload was partial: hot-applicable sections (vars, ...) are applied, while the auth section (including anonymous endpoints) needs a host restart.

confirm.uninstallBody: Uninstalling "{{name}}" affects the roles and users below, and the site must keep at least one locked module. This cannot be undone. Continue?
confirm.impactEmpty: No affected roles or users (orphan solution)

rollback.title: Rollback version
rollback.body: Pick a prior version to roll "{{name}}" back to (currently installed {{installed}}). Rollback reinstalls the chosen older version; if the migration diff check (R12) fails you will get a readable error.
rollback.noCandidates: No earlier version in history to roll back to
rollback.warning: Rollback reinstalls the chosen older version; it is rejected if the older migration is irreversible.
